text: Righto, science corner, and this ones for anyone whos ever felt guilty chucking out a dead phone battery. Aussie researchers are making real headway on cheaper, greener ways to recycle old batteries instead of them ending up in landfill.

speaker: alice
text: Which matters more than ever with everyone driving electric cars and carrying about six devices in their bag at any given time. The idea is you pull the valuable metals back out and use them again instead of digging up more of the earth for them.

speaker: charlie
text: Basically turning our tech rubbish bin into a bit of a gold mine, love that for us. Little breakthroughs like this dont always make the front page but theyre exactly the kind of quiet progress that adds up over time.
